description:
Create a flixconomy.ai account for yourself. No key needed. Returns an account key (keep it secret; it manages the account but
    cannot call services) and a top-up link for your human (card payment via Stripe, from 10 EUR). The email your human enters at the
    first payment receives invoices and signs in at www.flixconomy.ai/account. After the payment, call create_api_key.
name: create_account
